ac-750w-port-side-exhaust.description: Dual NXA-PAC-750W-PE supplies and six NXA-SFAN-35CFM-PE fan modules: port-side exhaust airflow, blue latches. The guide's Overview gives the colours.

ac-750w-port-side-intake.description: Dual NXA-PAC-750W-PI supplies and six NXA-SFAN-35CFM-PI fan modules: port-side intake airflow, burgundy latches

dc-1100w-port-side-exhaust.description: Dual NXA-PDC-1100W-PE DC supplies and six NXA-SFAN-35CFM-PE fan modules: port-side exhaust airflow, blue latches

description: 36x 40/100G QSFP28 1RU data-centre leaf switch running NX-OS. The port side carries the thirty-six cages in two rows of eighteen, four lamps and a lane select button. The other side carries six fan modules, the console, an RJ-45 and an SFP management port, the USB port and two power supplies. Ships port-side intake (burgundy modules) or port-side exhaust (blue). A device of its own, not a configuration of the N9K-C9336C-FX2: its guide draws six fan modules where the other draws three.

gaps.note: The guide's Switch Dimensions row names the switch "N9336C-FC2-E". Every other row, the title and the kit table say FX2-E. The part number carried is N9K-C9336C-FX2-E.

gaps.wanted: A larger picture of the left end. The figure's callout 1 names "LEDs", draws four round lamps and prints no legend that can be read; appendix C names BCN, STS and ENV only. The fourth lamp is read as the lane lamp the twin guide describes.

A larger picture of the foot of the front. The figure prints two rows of small boxes under the cages that carry the port numbers, too small to read; the numbering is the library's convention (odd on the top row), not a reading.
A round push-button part about 6.5 mm across. The registry's reset button is a 4 mm pinhole and stands in for the lane select button.

gaps.note: The guide lists a 1100 W AC supply (NXA-PAC-1100W-PE3, -PI3, -PE and -PI). cisco/nxa-pac-1100w@1 is drawn 84.7 mm wide from another guide's figure and this guide's supply bay is 56.0 mm wide; the bay would reserve less room than a module it accepts. The part is not accepted and no configuration seats it.
gaps.wanted: A stated size for the 1100 W AC supply, and a new version of cisco/nxa-pac-1100w if it is 56 mm wide here.

gaps.note: The guide lists the NXA-FAN-35CFM and the NXA-SFAN-35CFM. The bay is sized to the figure and to cisco/nxa-sfan-35cfm@1 (40.8 by 40.7); cisco/nxa-fan-35cfm@1 is 39.9 by 39.3, from another guide's figure, and one module may not be reserved two bay sizes. Only the SFAN is accepted.
gaps.wanted: A stated size for each fan module.

gaps.note: The weights table gives 2.1 lb (0.95 kg) for the 750 W AC supply and one row, 2.36 lb (1.07 kg), for six 1100 W supplies, AC and DC. No weight is carried for the 1100 W DC supply.

gaps.wanted: A picture of the 750 W supply by its rating and of the 1100 W DC supply. The guide's figure shows AC supplies and does not say the rating; the 750 W AC supply takes the figure and the 1100 W DC supply is drawn from it with a plain recess for the inlet.

gaps.note: The guide's installation options name "Rack-mount kit (N3K-C3064-ACC-KIT) which you can order from Cisco" and say nothing else of it, and its airflow sleeve (N9K-AIRFLOW-SLV) is "only compatible with" it. The sleeve's rail depth table (806.90 to 898.70 mm for this switch) is the sleeve's and not the kit's. Appendix D lists the NXK-ACC-KIT-1RU: two front brackets, two rear brackets, two slider rails and ten M4 screws, and a ground lug kit.
gaps.wanted: The N3K-C3064-ACC-KIT's contents and its rack depth range. It is not listed under the kits of this device, because a kit needs parts and a range.

A drawing of the lid, the underside and the two side walls. The guide's three-quarter view (art number 503530) shows the lid with its SSD cover and one side wall with six screw holes for mounting brackets and a grounding pad; none is flat and none can be measured.
A larger picture of the rear. The figure prints legends on the supplies, the fan modules and beside the jacks; at 2.9 px per mm none can be read.

gaps.note: The Overview says each fan module has two rotors and the switch works with one rotor failed in any one module; with more than one rotor failed it warns and powers down in two minutes. It states no count of modules that may fail.
gaps.wanted: How many of the six modules the switch survives losing. No redundancy is claimed.

attrs.redundancy-note: Installation guide, Overview: six fan modules of two rotors each; the switch works with one rotor failed in any one module. It states no module count that may fail, so none is claimed.

mgmt.mixed: the out-of-band block between the fan modules and the second supply: an RJ-45 console port, an RJ-45 and an SFP management port and a USB port. Three media, one purpose: reaching the switch when the data plane cannot.

attrs.redundancy-note: installation guide: "Power supply modules (two-One for operations and one for redundancy [1+1])". Slot 1 is on the left and slot 2 on the right.

name: n9k-c9336c-fx2-e

chassis-lamps.note: Callout 1 is "LEDs" and the figure draws FOUR round lamps in a column at the left end, and below them a ring that is callout 2, the lane select button. Appendix C lists three chassis lamps, BCN, STS and ENV, "located on the left side of the front of the switch", and a lane link LED text exists in the twin guide only. The first three lamps are named for the table's three, in the table's order, top to bottom, and the fourth is the lane lamp: THE FIGURE PRINTS NO LEGEND THAT CAN BE READ and the order is a reading, not a printed fact. The figure's small marks at the logo's place are not drawn: the library's practice for a Cisco face is no logo artwork.

colour.note: NO SOURCE FOR THE COLOUR. The guide's figures are uncoloured line art. #d0d2cf is the value the 93180YC-EX's stencil sample gave, carried across as a family colour.

gate-1.note: The front figure's body, between its two end lines, is about 1269 px across and 126.5 px down: aspect 10.03 against the guide's 17.3 x 1.72 in, 10.06, so 0.3% out, and it can be measured; 2.888 px per mm. The rear figure's body is 1274 px across and 126 px down: aspect 10.1, 0.5% out; 2.899 px per mm. A repeated feature checks the scale: the supply and fan modules fill the width, 2 x 56.0 + 6 x 45.4 + the out-of-band block, 439 mm.

port-lamps.note: Appendix C, Switch Chassis LEDs: "The port LEDs appear as triangles pointing up or down to the nearest port." Green is admin up, module present and link up; amber is admin down or module absent; off is up and present but no link. The figure draws an up triangle and a down triangle at the ends of the strip between each stacked pair, with four small windows between them; the windows are drawn nowhere and carry no state.

port-order.note: The figure prints numbers in boxes along the foot of the face, two rows of small boxes too small to read. Ports number 1-36, as the guide's text says ("36 40/100-Gigabit QSFP28 ports"; "Fiber Channel (FC) transceivers are supported on ports 9-36 only"), and run down each column, odd on the top row, which is the library's convention for a stacked pair and the way the 93180YC-FX3 prints its uplinks; THE FIGURE DOES NOT SHOW IT. Port numbers are as printed; the NX-OS interface names are not in the guide.

power.note: Appendix B, Switch Power Input Requirements: typical 321 W and maximum 702 W "(AC or DC)", 2395.323 BTU per hour. The figures are the switch's draw and not a supply rating; the guide notes that optics of 5 W or more on all 36 ports need the 1100 W supplies. No held document prints a draw for one fan module (cisco/nxa-sfan-35cfm) or splits the switch's draw; none is derived by dividing it.

rack-ears.note: The guide's NXK-ACC-KIT-1RU procedure (PDF page 28, printed 22) says the holes used depend on the rack and on the clearance needed for interface cables, 3 inches minimum, and for module handles, 1 inch minimum, and its figure shows two ways to mount the brackets. None dimensions a position and none says which the box ships with, so the two positions are written without an `at`, named for what the text says they clear, and none is the default.

rear-face.note: Every x and y on the module side is read off the rear figure (1274 px across, 2.899 px per mm). Supply 1, six fan modules numbered 1 (left) to 6 (right), then the out-of-band block (the console jack over the RJ-45 management jack, the SFP management port, the USB port) and supply 2: callouts 3, 4, 5 and 6 and the guide's rule that slots are "numbered 1 (left) and 2 (right)". The out-of-band block sits between the fans and supply 2. The fan frame reads about 41.4 mm across and 40.7 down, and each bay reserves 40.8 by 40.7, the size of cisco/nxa-sfan-35cfm@1. The supply frame reads 55.9 by 41.0 mm and each supply bay reserves 56.0 by 41.0. The figure's printed legends, the two small lamp boxes under the jacks and the ground screw are not readable beyond the screw, which is placed.

sources.note: One guide, held as PDF and as converted text and figures; it is not committed. Cisco N9336C-FX2-E NX-OS Mode Switch Hardware Installation Guide, First Published 2021-02-16, Last Modified 2026-07-27, 66 pages: the overview and its flat front figure (art number 503528, PDF page 8, printed 2), flat rear figure (503529, PDF page 9, printed 3) and three-quarter view (503530), appendix B specifications (PDF page 55, printed 49), appendix C LEDs, appendix D kits. NO DATA SHEET, PHOTOGRAPH, 3D MODEL OR STENCIL IS HELD for this model (the Nexus 9300-FX2 Series data sheet is not in the intake), and the NetBox devicetype-library is held as a path listing only: it names no device type for this model and no file was read. The Cisco N9336C-FX2 guide (a twin, 2018-03-12, last modified 2026-07-16) was read for the decision below and for the callouts it prints; none of its figures, which are three-quarter views only, is drawn from. THE FX2-E IS A DEVICE OF ITS OWN: its rear figure draws six fan modules and the twin's text says three fan modules, its supplies sit at both ends of the rear in a 56 mm bay where the twin's guide gives no flat figure to compare, and the two guides pair different fans with their chassis (NXA-FAN-35CFM and NXA-SFAN-35CFM here, NXA-FAN-65CFM and NXA-SFAN-65CFM there).

the-width.note: The guide's Switch Dimensions table (PDF page 55, printed 49): "17.3 inches (43.9 cm)" wide, "24.7 inches (62.7 cm)" deep, "1.72 inches (4.4 cm) (1 RU)" high; the figures are carried as inches converted. THE DEPTH COLUMN IS HEADED "Depth" ONLY: it states no inclusion. The twin guide heads its column "Depth with Handles" and prints 24.5 in (62.3 cm); the 0.2 in difference is declared, not explained, and the twin's figure is not applied to this model. 627.4 mm is carried as the chassis depth because it is the only figure the FX2-E guide prints; whether it counts the module handles is not said. THE DIMENSION ROW NAMES THE SWITCH "N9336C-FC2-E" (a typo for FX2; the weights, power and kit rows say N9K-C9336C-FX2-E). The part number carried is N9K-C9336C-FX2-E and the guide's spelling is declared here and not carried. The weights table gives the chassis 18.8 lb (8.5 kg); 8.5 kg is carried.

the-x-axis.note: From the front figure at 2.888 px per mm, origin the left end line. Eighteen stacked cage pairs: the first cage's outline starts at 18.7 mm and the last at 411.0, a pitch of 23.08 mm; each outline is 20.7 mm wide, so the registry's 20.0 mm opening is centred in it (x 19.05). The four lamps stand 12.4 mm from the end line and the lane select button is centred there.

the-y-axis.note: From the same figure, origin the top line. The upper cage opening starts 9.5 mm down and the lower 26.7 mm, a row pitch of 17.2 mm; the strip between the two cages carries the printed arrows and four lane windows, centred at 22.7 mm. The lamps stand at 12.2, 16.3, 20.4 and 24.2 mm and the button's centre at 31.0 mm, 6.5 mm across.
